documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Communication To Shareholders
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Management discussed Q1 FY27 financial performance, noting significantly higher profits driven by better realizations despite lower sales volumes and war-related input cost pressures. Several plants that were previously shut down due to cost economics have resumed operations in July. The company outlined ongoing capex projects, including the Dahej steam and power project which is providing cost relief by replacing costly gas with coal. Management also highlighted positive revisions in fertilizer energy norms and ongoing cost-saving initiatives. Management reported that Q1 FY 26-27 revenue marginally increased due to improved realizations across products, while results were impacted by higher input and fixed costs.

guidance.claim: The company states as a matter of policy that it does not provide any forecast about the future business situation.
guidance.quote: As a matter of policy, we do not provide any forecast about the future business situation.

guidance.claim: Management does not comment or give guidance on future results or business outlook.
guidance.quote: We do not comment or give guidance on future results or business outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that there is a shortage of TDI in the Indian market.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for ammonium nitrate is supported by a CAGR of around 6% to 7% and government thrust on coal mining.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the ammonium nitrate is concerned, CAGR is around 6% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: International trends for acetic acid and ethyl acetate prices are showing a reducing trend.
demand_outlook.quote: Presently, as far as the international trend is concerned, the acetic acid as well as ethyl acetate trends are in reducing trend, both the prices.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that out of four ongoing projects, the overdue project of Dahej has started producing.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the projects, the -- out of the 4 ongoing projects, the overdue project of Dahej has started producing now.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred in Q1 was INR300 crores in CWIP.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex incurred was INR300 crores in CWIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the targeted capex for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeted for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the total projects on hand are of INR2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Okay. The total projects on hand are of INR2,800 crores, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Ammonia Expansion at Bharuch with a capacity of 50 KTPA is under execution.
Weak Nitric Acid –III at Bharuch with a capacity of 200 KTPA is under execution.
Ammonium Nitrate –II at Bharuch with a capacity of 163 KTPA is under execution.
New CFBC Steam Boiler at Bharuch with 180 ~ 200 MT/HR capacity is under execution.
capex_expansion.quote: 5. New CFBC Steam Boiler – Bharuch 180 ~ 200 MT/HR

capex_expansion.claim: BisPhenol-A (BPA) – Dahej of 150 KTPA is under consideration.
The company has planned a capex of around INR 2,800 crores for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid, and ammonia expansion projects are on track.
capex_expansion.quote: See, both these 3 projects actually, ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid and ammonia expansion are going on track.

capex_expansion.claim: The dialogue with INEOS is ongoing regarding licensing for additional capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Now we are talking to them about licensing for additional capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that energy norms for urea have been revised from 6.20 Gcal to 6.37 Gcal per metric ton.
margins_costs.quote: It was 6.20 Gcal per metric ton of urea, which is revised to 6.37 Gcal now.

margins_costs.claim: During Q-o-Q Q1, revenue marginally increased mainly due to improved realization across all of the products, which was partially offset by lower volume in a majority of products.
margins_costs.quote: During Q-o-Q Q 1, Revenue marginally increased mainly due to improved realisation across all of the products, which is partially offset by lower volume in majority of products.

margins_costs.claim: Results decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.
margins_costs.quote: Result is decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.

margins_costs.claim: There will be a positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 from the new energy norm of Neem Coated Urea.
margins_costs.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year profit was mainly driven by benign raw material prices in relative terms.
margins_costs.quote: Main reasons driving this profit is the better realization in case of chemicals, mainly in Q4 both sequential Q4 and Y-o-Y Q4, whereas on a full year basis, it is mainly the impact of benign raw material prices, which are in relative terms benign.

margins_costs.claim: Losses are widening in the fertilizer segment as revisions in urea fixed cost and energy norms are overdue.
margins_costs.quote: In case of fertilizer, the revision both in urea of fixed cost as well as energy norms are yet to happen. And this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

margins_costs.claim: Methanol production economics were affected due to very high gas prices.
margins_costs.quote: Whereas in case of methanol, the cost economics did not work out given the very high gas price.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that except for ANP, acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI, all other plants operated beyond rated capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: I will say that except ANP, acetic and Ethyl and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter. Rest all the plants have operated beyond the rated capacity, whether it is ammonia, urea, both with nitric acid.

orders_capacity.claim: Chemical and most plant capacities are running at peak capacity utilization above 100%, while TDI operates close to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Management: See, plants are running at a peak capacity. Capacity utilization in case of acetic and most of the plants is above 100%. So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that cash on hand in the books is around INR4,000 crores.
The board has declared a dividend of 210% at INR 21 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering all this, Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%. This is INR21 per share, which is historically the second highest dividend in its history of 50 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that during Q1, escalation and deescalation of war had a ripple effect on business, causing viability issues and higher input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Overall, during the quarter 1, it has been the situation of escalation and deescalation as far as war is concerned. And that has a ripple effect on the business as well, in terms of, at times, viability issues, at times, realizations, which have gone up. Similarly, the input costs have also gone up because of the war situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI plants could not run for cost economics reasons during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this quarter gone by, there are plants which we could not run for cost economics reason, like acetic acid, ethyl acetate and to some extent, TDI as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and is proactively taking necessary actions to safeguard the interest of all stakeholders.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and are proactively taking necessary actions to safeguard interest of all
Stakeholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: The continuing war has changed the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.
risks_headwinds.quote: The continuing war has change the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.

risks_headwinds.claim: War-related logistics disruptions impacted urea volumes, which were partially recouped by utilizing technical grade urea facilities.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now coming to the operating performance, the quarter 4 performance in terms of chemical volumes has been better, whereas there is some impact of war in case of urea, which is recouped to some extent by utilizing the facility of technical grade urea.

risks_headwinds.claim: Acetic acid production volume was capped due to internal calculated issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is acetic acid and second is methanol. There is -- in case of acetic acid, we had certain internal calculated issues because of which the volume was capped -- production volume was capped, which did not result into the sales volume, therefore.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the energy norm revision for urea is valid for a 3-year period starting from FY25-26.
management_commitments.quote: This has been revised for a period from FY25-26, and valid for 3 years period.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the power portion of the Dahej steam and power project to come in a month's time or around 45 days.
management_commitments.quote: And power, we are expecting to come in a month's time or so or around 45 days' time.

management_commitments.claim: The positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.
management_commitments.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

management_commitments.claim: The coal-based CCPP is scheduled for synchronization in the third week of June and performance guarantee test run in the third week of August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June. And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

management_commitments.claim: Clarity on new projects identification for investment table-grade decisions will be reached by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: The new projects identification will have clarity by end of this calendar year for taking it to the investment table-grade decisions.

management_commitments.claim: Ammonia expansion, weak nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt projects are expected to come up by next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, next year, these are going to come up. All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
